propositions: Three independent implementations of detached rebar child spawning (push.py, enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py) duplicate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, stdio discipline, and cwd logic across separate sites.
Bug 3198-438c-72a5-470f (missing cwd parameter) propagated to all three sites identically through deliberate copy-paste imitation across tickets, demonstrating structural risk.
A single consolidated helper spawn_detached() in _proc.py must own the PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and durable cwd while remaining stdlib-only and re-raising on failure.
A static test must enforce that detached rebar spawn tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future fourth copy-paste sites.
Per-site exception handling and env construction (push.py's secret-stripping vs drain/sweep's broad catch) remain at call sites; _proc.py consolidation changes no exception surface.
